scope: Compass map presentation and viewport only. The custom-design page keeps its balanced split.
browser_checks: Rooms starts collapsed; all 16, 24 and 32 cells fit inside the map viewport.
Desktop Rooms palette slides in a narrow column; Hide returns the full width to the canvas.
The hidden drawer has aria-hidden and inert; Escape hides it and returns focus to the Rooms button.
Selected room is retained with the drawer hidden, with a placement indicator and Next room action.
Room placement works with the drawer open or closed; Undo and Redo retain original ownership checks.
Room creation, room detail dimensions, cell refinement and arrow-key navigation remain reachable.
Zoom enlarges cells; Fit plot restores the complete map without changing plot proportions.
Retained 32-cell project reopens with split ownership and its reviewed geometry still accepted.
Road remains below the plot and labels frontage and facing direction.

preservation.original_planning_documents: Both SHA-256 hashes still match their recorded safety copies.

limitations: Desktop browser validation; no physical mobile-device acceptance session.
